root_cause_label: Agent misread &&-short-circuit silence as missing fasttext, then installed into wrong environment (/opt/miniswea) with NumPy 2.x, never identifying or patching the np.array(copy=False) incompatibility in the system site-packages
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent misinterpreted the &&-short-circuit output as 'fasttext not installed', installed it into the wrong environment with incompatible NumPy 2.x, and then validated only list-based prediction via an ad-hoc script while never patching the single-string predict path that the benchmark tests.
t_err_evidence: pip3 install fasttext installs into /opt/miniswea and pulls NumPy 2.x, the wrong environment-and-dependency remediation strategy
t_commit_evidence: After step 2, fasttext is locked into /opt/miniswea (wrong env) with NumPy 2.4.1 (incompatible); subsequent steps 3-10 never attempt to patch the system fasttext file or fix the numpy incompatibility, making failure inevitable
t_surface_evidence: ValueError:  cannot be opened for training!
trigger_explanation: In step 1 the command 'python3 --version && pip3 list | grep fasttext && python3 -c ...' short-circuits after python3 --version because pip3 list | grep fasttext produces no output (fasttext not found), but the agent in step 2 misinterprets this silence as 'the pip list command didn't complete' rather than 'fasttext is not in the current pip environment'. This misreading leads it to install fasttext via pip3 (which targets /opt/miniswea, not the system site-packages) with a NumPy 2.x dependency, creating the incompatible configuration.
